players.product: Niche DRAM (DDR4, DDR3L, LPDDR4X) plus NOR flash and SLC NAND flash (fabless)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 9,203,463,124.58, up 25.12%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,648,022,651.70, up 49.47%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,469,196,552.72, up 42.57%; main-business gross margin 40.21% (up 2.21 points). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 1,909,062,290.61, Q2 RMB 2,241,246,342.27, Q3 RMB 2,681,325,810.90, Q4 RMB 2,371,828,680.80; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 234,630,087.42, Q2 RMB 340,845,518.40, Q3 RMB 507,752,274.22, Q4 RMB 564,794,771.66. The company attributes the growth to an upward memory cycle in which better supply-demand lifted both product prices and volumes, its AI-related new businesses (customised memory, higher-compute MCU and AI MCU) and its diversified product range.

Products and volumes (annual report): memory chips revenue RMB 6,565,939,969.50 in 2025, up 26.41%, gross margin 42.84% (up 2.57 points); MCU RMB 1,909,897,922.87, up 12.98%, gross margin 35.82%; sensors RMB 389,354,949.48, down 13.15%; analog RMB 332,843,600.57, up 2,051.82% (mainly the Suzhou Saixin analog business acquired before the end of 2024). Memory chips output 4,527.18 million units (+21.31%), sales 4,435.85 million units (+24.84%), year-end inventory 548.89 million units (+19.35%); MCU sales 500.34 million units (+22.26%). Revenue by registered location of distributors / direct customers: mainland China RMB 2,787,347,162.94, Hong Kong RMB 4,319,595,765.91, other countries and regions RMB 2,095,315,050.07; agent sales RMB 8,354,052,638.76 versus direct sales RMB 848,205,340.16.

quarterly_data.signal: Memory supply in 2025 (annual report): as overseas majors sped their exit from niche DRAM, the niche market was clearly short of supply, and from Q2 2025 GigaDevice's niche DRAM rose in both volume and price with gross margin improving markedly quarter on quarter; DDR4 took a larger share of DRAM revenue, the new DDR4 8Gb (TV and industrial customers) became an important part of niche DRAM revenue, and LPDDR4 began contributing revenue. SLC NAND flash revenue fell YoY in H1 2025 on low prices and margins, but in H2 2025, with overseas majors leaving 2D NAND and a clear supply gap, SLC NAND rose in volume and price and revenue grew strongly. NOR flash revenue and shipments grew, with prices starting to rise mildly in H2 2025; the company says it was one of the first to mass-produce 45nm SPI NOR flash. At the report date the company said all of its memory products face tight supply with prices rising accordingly.
Top five customers (annual report): combined sales RMB 28.23 hundred million, 30.67% of 2025 sales; names not disclosed; no related-party sales among the top five (0).

quarterly_data.signal: Top five suppliers (annual report): combined purchases RMB 50.14 hundred million, 69.49% of 2025 purchases; related-party purchases among the top five RMB 11.82 hundred million, 16.38% of purchases; names not disclosed in the table. The company runs a fabless model with no capacity of its own: wafer manufacturing, packaging and testing are outsourced; raw materials were 72.27% of integrated-circuit product cost.
quarterly_data.figure: top five suppliers 69.49% of 2025 purchases; related party 16.38%

quarterly_data.signal: Customised memory (annual report): at subsidiary Qingyun Technology some customised-memory projects entered customer sampling and small-batch trial production in H2 2025, with key customer and project wins in AI phones, AI PCs and robots; contract liabilities rose 130.79% to RMB 218,174,401.41, mainly on performance obligations of the customised-memory business. The company says pilot projects launched by some customers proved the solution's system-level advantages.

R&D and projects (annual report): total R&D investment RMB 1,404,156,680.07 in 2025, 15.26% of revenue, of which RMB 287,164,721.06 capitalised (20.45%); R&D spending up about 11.8%; 1,533 R&D staff (65.71% of employees). The raised-fund DRAM chip R&D and industrialisation project (planned RMB 2,824,137,468.04; RMB 1,022,894,463.11 invested, 36.22%) is due to reach ready-for-use status in December 2028; several DDR3 and DDR4 projects under it are in mass production and it generated RMB 381,509,815.30 of benefit in 2025. The automotive electronics chip project (RMB 706,441,198.10, 6.14% invested) is also due in December 2028.
